Implement step A6 of the SFCC-83/84 Recently Viewed build plan (`~/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-83+84/plan.md`, section "### A6 — Wire the container branch; remove the copy-first markers", lines 488-535). Branch: `feature/SFCC-83-84_recently-viewed` (already checked out — do not switch branches).

This step has two parts, both required, both bundled into this one step per the plan.

## Part 1 — `overrides/app/components/recommended-products/index.tsx`

Currently this file always renders `<ProductScroller ref={ref} .../>` (see its current content — read it first). Add a branch: when `recommender === EINSTEIN_RECOMMENDERS.PDP_RECENTLY_VIEWED`, render the new `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` instead; for every other recommender (PDP Complete-the-Set, PDP Might-Also-Like, Cart May-Also-Like, add-to-cart-modal, both PLP empty-search rails), keep rendering `<ProductScroller>` **exactly as today, byte-identical** — do not touch that branch's JSX, hooks, or logic at all.

`EINSTEIN_RECOMMENDERS` is a real export from `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/constants` (`EINSTEIN_RECOMMENDERS.PDP_RECENTLY_VIEWED` and `.CART_RECENTLY_VIEWED` both resolve to the same string, `'viewed-recently-einstein'` — confirmed in `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/constants.js:154-160` — so one check on `PDP_RECENTLY_VIEWED` correctly matches both PDP's and Cart's usage of this component). Import it the normal way (this file already imports several things from that same base package path — e.g. `API_ERROR_MESSAGE` — via `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/constants`, follow that exact existing import style, just add to the same import).

**New imports needed, all by relative path** (per `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` > "Importing an already-overridden component from a new component" — `.storybook/main.js` and `vitest.config.ts` don't load the overrides resolver, so a base-package-path import of an already-overridden component would silently test/story the wrong thing):
- `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` from `'../ui-kits/organisms/zimmRecentlyViewedRail'` (confirm the exact relative path yourself by checking the real folder depth — `recommended-products/` and `ui-kits/organisms/zimmRecentlyViewedRail/` are both direct children of `overrides/app/components/`).
- `selectRecentlyViewedCard` (and its types, if needed) from `overrides/app/utils/recentlyViewedCard.ts` — plain relative import (this one isn't shadowing a base SFCC module, so it's just a normal relative import, not the resolver-workaround case above — but still relative, since this file lives inside `overrides/`).
- `useRecentlyViewedGate` from `overrides/app/hooks/useRecentlyViewedGate.ts` — plain relative import, same reasoning.

**Hook call — rules-of-hooks matters here.** Call `const hasRecentlyViewed = useRecentlyViewedGate();` unconditionally at the top level, alongside this file's other hook calls (`useEinstein()`, `useCurrentCustomer()`, etc.) — specifically **before** the file's existing early-return at the line reading `if (!isLoading && (!recommendations || recommendations.length < 1)) { return null; }`. Do not call it conditionally or after that return.

**Price formatting for the mapper.** `selectRecentlyViewedCard(product, formatPrice)` needs a `formatPrice: (amount: number, currency: string) => string` function. This file already has `const intl = useIntl();`. Build it the same way the already-merged PLP quick-test integration does it (`overrides/app/pages/product-list/productListCardMapper.ts` is consumed by `overrides/app/pages/product-list/index.tsx` with exactly this pattern — look at that file's `formatPrice` definition for the precedent): `const formatPrice = (amount: number, currency: string) => intl.formatNumber(amount, { style: 'currency', currency });`. Define it once, near the top of the component body alongside the other derived values, not inline in the render.

**The `isOnScreen`/impression-tracking gotcha — read carefully.** The existing effect:
```ts
useEffect(() => {
  if (isOnScreen && recommendations?.recs) {
    sendViewReco(...)
    dataCloud.sendViewRecommendations(...)
  }
}, [isOnScreen, recommendations]);
```
depends on `isOnScreen`, which comes from `useIntersectionObserver(ref, {useOnce: true})` — and `ref` only becomes a real DOM node because `<ProductScroller ref={ref} .../>` forwards it. `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` (A5) is a plain function component with **no `ref`/`forwardRef` support at all** — passing `ref={ref}` directly to it would do nothing (React would warn and `ref.current` would stay `null` forever), silently breaking `isOnScreen` and therefore silently dropping the impression-tracking calls on this one branch — exactly the regression the plan's own pass criteria explicitly warns against ("must survive on the Recently Viewed branch too... silently dropping them... would be a real regression"). Confirmed via `useIntersectionObserver`'s own source (`node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-intersection-observer.js`): it only needs `ref.current` to be *some* real DOM element — it has no dependency on which component produced it.

**Fix: wrap the rendered `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` in a plain element that carries the ref**, e.g.:
```tsx
<Box ref={ref}>
  <ZimmRecentlyViewedRail title={...} cards={...} />
</Box>
```
(`Box` from `@chakra-ui/react`, or a plain `<div ref={ref}>` if you prefer — either is fine, this is purely a ref-attachment point, not a styled element; don't add any visual styling to it). This keeps the fix entirely inside this one file and doesn't require touching `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` itself (already committed and verified as its own step, A5) at all. Do **not** add `forwardRef` to `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` — that would mean reopening an already-verified, already-committed component for a concern that a one-line wrapper in the caller solves just as well.

**The branch itself**, replacing the current unconditional `return <ProductScroller .../>`:
```tsx
if (recommender === EINSTEIN_RECOMMENDERS.PDP_RECENTLY_VIEWED) {
  if (!hasRecentlyViewed) {
    return null;
  }
  const cards = (recommendations.recs ?? [])
    .map((rec) => selectRecentlyViewedCard(rec, formatPrice))
    .filter((card): card is NonNullable<typeof card> => card !== null);
  return (
    <Box ref={ref}>
      <ZimmRecentlyViewedRail title={title || recommendations?.displayMessage} cards={cards} />
    </Box>
  );
}
return (
  <ProductScroller ref={ref} ... /* exactly as today, unchanged */ />
);
```
(Pseudocode — write real TypeScript matching this file's actual current variable names/types; check `selectRecentlyViewedCard`'s actual exported signature in `overrides/app/utils/recentlyViewedCard.ts` yourself rather than trusting my paraphrase of it.) `seeAllHref`/`seeAllLabel` are **not** wired here — B2/B3 (later steps) own the "See Full History" link's actual trigger condition and href; for this step, just don't pass those two props at all (they're both optional on `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`).

**Remove the A1 copy-first marker**: delete the `console.log('[overrides] recommended-products/index.tsx')` line, and delete the docblock paragraph at the top of the file describing it as temporary (starts "A temporary `console.log(...)` marker sits at the top...").

**Do not touch:** the dead check `if (!isLoading && (!recommendations || recommendations.length < 1))` — this is base-SFCC dead code (`recommendations` is always an object, `.length` is always `undefined`, so this branch can never actually trigger on a real "no recommendations" case) that must be **preserved byte-identical**, not fixed, per this repo's Minimal Changes rule. Just note in your final report that it's still there and still dead, so it makes it into the PR body later — do not silently "fix" it.

## Part 2 — `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx`

Line 60 currently reads:
```ts
import RecommendedProducts from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/recommended-products';
```
Change this to a relative import pointing at the override file instead (`overrides/app/components/recommended-products/index.tsx` — work out the correct relative path from `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx`). This is required, not optional: this file's import is issued from *inside* `overrides/`, and the resolver's `isFromExtends` check (`overrides-plugin.js:128-146`) only redirects a package-path import when the *issuing* file is outside `overrides/` — so today, PDP's three `<RecommendedProducts>` usages (Complete-the-Set, Might-Also-Like, and the one at `EINSTEIN_RECOMMENDERS.PDP_RECENTLY_VIEWED` this whole feature depends on) are all silently rendering the **base, unmodified** SFCC component, not this override, and would keep doing so even after Part 1 above is done. Cart needs no equivalent change — Cart's own `recommended-products` import lives in `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/cart/index.jsx`, issued from *outside* `overrides/`, so the resolver already redirects it correctly today.

Change only this one import line. Do not touch anything else in this large file.

## Testing — create `overrides/app/components/recommended-products/index.test.tsx` (does not exist yet)

Mock `useEinstein`, `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`, and `ProductScroller` each at the smallest surface (e.g. `vi.mock('../ui-kits/organisms/zimmRecentlyViewedRail', () => ({ZimmRecentlyViewedRail: vi.fn(() => null)}))` — check the real module's export shape first). Also mock `useRecentlyViewedGate` and `selectRecentlyViewedCard`. Assert **only the branch logic**, not `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`'s or `ProductScroller`'s own internals (both already have their own test coverage elsewhere — `.claude/rules/testing.md`'s no-duplicate-coverage rule):
1. `recommender: EINSTEIN_RECOMMENDERS.PDP_RECENTLY_VIEWED` + gate returns `true` → `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail` is rendered (not `ProductScroller`).
2. Any other `recommender` value → `ProductScroller` is rendered (not `ZimmRecentlyViewedRail`), regardless of what the gate returns.
3. `recommender: EINSTEIN_RECOMMENDERS.PDP_RECENTLY_VIEWED` + gate returns `false` → renders `null` (neither component rendered).

You'll need to mock `useCurrentCustomer`, `useWishList`, `useIntersectionObserver`, `useDataCloud`, `useShopperCustomersMutation`, `useToast`, `useNavigation` and wrap in `IntlProvider` — check how this file's dependencies are typically mocked elsewhere in this codebase (e.g. any existing test that already exercises a component composing `useEinstein`) before inventing your own approach from scratch.

## Before you report done

Run these yourself and fix anything you introduce:
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — must be clean.
- `npm run lint` on the two files you modified plus the new test file.
- `npx vitest run overrides/app/components/recommended-products/index.test.tsx` — must pass.
- `grep -n "from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/recommended-products'" overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` — must return zero hits.
- `grep -n "console.log" overrides/app/components/recommended-products/index.tsx` — must return zero hits.

I cannot run the dev server myself (project convention — only the developer runs `npm start`), so I will not be able to verify the rail actually *renders* on a live PDP/Cart page myself; that verification happens separately after you report back. Do not attempt to start the dev server yourself either.

Report back: the exact diff shape for both files (what changed, in plain terms), the new test file's contents summarized, confirmation of all five checks above, and any judgment call you had to make that wasn't fully spelled out here.

# SFCC-83 + SFCC-84 — Build Plan

**Produced:** 2026-09-06 · **Gate:** `findings.md` (four passes, cleared at the 2026-09-06 adjudication)
**Base branch:** `feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component` (PR #85, open, unmerged)

## 1. Goal statement

Build the Recently Viewed rail and its full-history page per **SFCC-83** and **SFCC-84** (ACs in Jira
`customfield_10231`), designed in **`Zimmermann_Design_System_2026` component set `40000587:38471`**
(Desktop `40000307:12444`, Tablet `40000730:13363`, Mobile `40000538:25030` — all authoritative,
corroborated by PDP-template instances `7998:13508` / `8272:28947`), with SFCC-84's page from the
**provisional** `Zimmermann_Designs` `3332:35655` — following `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md`
(token hierarchy) and `.claude/rules/components.md` (container/presentational split), and extending
**PR #85 / SFCC-236's** `ZimmProductCard` family via a **new `VARIATION_CONFIG` entry** (not a new
card), a **copy-first override of `recommended-products/`**, and **co-located `<name>.css.ts`**
recipes registered in `theme/components/index.ts`.

Scope follows `.docs/prd/search.md` §7.4 (PDP + Cart). **PLP is out**; SFCC-83 AC 9 knowingly not met.
**No consent gating** (development-phase carve-out, Marcel 2026-09-06) — must be stated in both PR
bodies; must not reach production.

## 2. Scale call

### Architecture fork — resolved: override `recommended-products/`, which removes the Cart port

Verified directly at `node_modules/@salesforce/pwa-kit-dev/configs/webpack/overrides-plugin.js`.
`isFromExtends` returns true when the request names `@salesforce/retail-react-app` **and the issuing
file is not itself inside `overrides/`**. The plugin's own comment (lines 116–127): *"This will return
true if the issuer is a file in a base template... This allow the base template to import from
overrides."* Implementation: `this.extends.includes(pkgName) && !filepath.includes(issuerPath)`.

Base Cart imports at `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/cart/index.jsx:36`:
`import RecommendedProducts from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/recommended-products'`
— a package-path import issued from a base file, so it **is** redirected once our override exists.
Base Cart is itself loaded by base `routes.jsx` via a relative `import('./pages/cart')`, which is not
redirected — so base Cart keeps rendering and picks up our override for free.

**Consequence: the ~2,460-line Cart copy-first (`index.jsx` 1515 + 8 real partials ≈ 948) is not
required.** This departed from adjudication item #10 ("we only have to copy-first for cart"), in the
direction of *less* work. **APPROVED by Marcel, 2026-09-06**, on the evidence that this is already the
dominant pattern in this repo: nine component overrides shadow base paths and are reached purely by
the resolver (`icons` at 64 base import sites — and mandated by AGENTS.md — `responsive` 12,
`product-view` 6, `drawer-menu`/`list-menu` 2 each, `header`/`footer` 1 each). The single page port
(`product-detail`) exists only because base `routes.jsx` loads pages by *relative* import, which the
resolver never redirects — a constraint that does not apply to components. Open Question 5 is closed.

**Caveat:** this is a *build-time webpack* resolver. It runs in the dev server and production build
only — **not** Storybook (`.storybook/main.js` aliases straight to `node_modules`) and **not** Vitest.
So the Cart behaviour cannot be proven by any automated test in this repo; it must be checked in the
running app. That is why A1's pause is a hard gate.

Cost of this choice: the override module loads at **four base import sites serving eight rails**, not
five as an earlier draft of this plan stated:

| Base import site | Rails | Takes the new branch? |
|---|---|---|
| `app/pages/cart/index.jsx:36` | Cart Recently Viewed, Cart May-Also-Like | **Yes** (1 of 2) |
| `app/pages/product-detail/index.jsx:40` | *(shadowed by our own PDP override — 3 rails)* | **Yes** (1 of 3) |
| `app/hooks/use-add-to-cart-modal.js:30` | add-to-cart modal (`pdp-similar-items`) | No |
| `app/pages/product-list/partials/empty-results.jsx:20` | PLP empty-search top-sellers, most-viewed | No |

1	/**
2	 * Maps one Recently Viewed recommendation onto the subset of `ZimmProductCard` props the
3	 * `recentlyViewed` variation (SFCC-83) actually renders.
4	 *
5	 * Input is exactly what `use-einstein.js`'s `fetchRecProductDetails` produces (search that name
6	 * in `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-einstein.js`): an Einstein rec
7	 * merged with its matching Commerce API product, fetched via `getProducts` with `expand:
8	 * ['availability', 'links', 'promotions', 'options', 'images', 'prices', 'variations']` —
9	 * `{...rec, ...product, productId: rec.id, image: {disBaseLink: rec.imageUrl, alt:
10	 * rec.productName}}`.
11	 *
12	 * Modelled on `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts` — no React/react-intl import,
13	 * `formatPrice` injected as a parameter so this module stays independently testable — and on the
14	 * general shape of `liveProductCardDemoMapper.ts` (`feature/zimmproductcard-live-demo`, not this
15	 * branch — read for its approach, not imported). Unlike that demo mapper, this is a production
16	 * path: real `commerce-sdk-isomorphic` SDK types are used wherever they exist (AGENTS.md > Type
17	 * Definitions), and only the two fields the SDK doesn't export (`productId`, the flat Einstein
18	 * `image`) are hand-rolled, each with its own why-comment below.
19	 *
20	 * Deliberately narrow scope, stated here rather than left as a silent gap: this mapper only ever
21	 * returns `currentPrice` (an active selling price). It does not attempt was/now sale-price
22	 * detection (`originalPrice`) — that needs `getPriceData`-style pricebook logic
23	 * (`productInfo.ts`'s own `PdpSourcePrice`) that this merged Einstein shape has no equivalent of,
24	 * and the `recentlyViewed` variation renders no price at all today (see
25	 * `zimmProductCard/index.tsx`'s `recentlyViewed` `VARIATION_CONFIG` row — `showContent: false`).
26	 * Mapping `currentPrice` anyway costs nothing and means a future consumer of this same mapper
27	 * (e.g. a variation that does render price) isn't blocked on this file being revisited.
28	 */
29	import type { ShopperProductsTypes } from 'commerce-sdk-isomorphic';
30	import { filterImageGroups } from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/product-utils';
31	import { productUrlBuilder } from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/url';
32	import type { ZimmProductCardBaseProps, ZimmProductCardImage } from '../components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard';
33	
34	/**
35	 * The real Commerce API `Product` (`commerce-sdk-isomorphic`'s own `ShopperProductsTypes.Product`
36	 * — not hand-rolled), plus the two fields `fetchRecProductDetails` bolts on that have no SDK
37	 * equivalent:
38	 */
39	export type RecentlyViewedProduct = ShopperProductsTypes.Product & {
40	  /** Set by `fetchRecProductDetails` to `rec.id`. Guaranteed present and equal to `Product.id`
41	   *  for every entry that function produces (it already filters out any rec with no matching
42	   *  product before this shape exists at all) — read this rather than `.id` only because it's
43	   *  the field the real runtime hook explicitly produces this way. */
44	  productId: string;
45	  /** The same function's own quick single-reference image (Einstein's own `rec.imageUrl`/
46	   *  `rec.productName`), distinct from the full product's own `imageGroups` array below — used
47	   *  as a fallback only when `imageGroups` filtering comes up empty. See `selectPrimaryImage`. */
48	  image?: { disBaseLink?: string; alt?: string };
49	};
50	
51	/** Formats a bare amount for the storefront. Injected so this module stays free of react-intl,
52	 *  mirroring `productInfo.ts`'s own `FormatPrice` shape. */
53	export type FormatPrice = (amount: number, currency: string) => string;
54	
55	/**
56	 * The subset of `ZimmProductCardBaseProps` this mapper populates. Deliberately excludes
57	 * `headingLevel` and `variation` — both are render-context decisions belonging to the container
58	 * step that maps recs through this mapper and renders the rail (SFCC-83's A6 step), which supplies
59	 * `headingLevel` uniformly for every card and adds `variation: 'recentlyViewed'` itself when
60	 * spreading this output into `<ZimmProductCard>` — the rail organism itself (A5) takes already-full
61	 * `ZimmProductCardProps` objects, so variation must already be set before it sees them. A pure data
62	 * mapper choosing a heading level would conflate a data concern with a layout one. Also excludes `hoverImage`/`images` — this
63	 * mapper only ever returns one image (`primaryImage`); see `selectPrimaryImage`'s own docblock
64	 * for why.
65	 */
66	export type RecentlyViewedCard = Pick<
67	  ZimmProductCardBaseProps,
68	  'id' | 'href' | 'name' | 'primaryImage' | 'currentPrice'
69	>;
70	
71	/** The correctly-sized product image view, per AGENTS.md's image-sizing guidance: never serve an
72	 *  arbitrary-sized image at thumbnail size. Named rather than inlined per conventions.md's
73	 *  no-magic-strings rule — this is a real, semantic SFCC image `viewType` key. */
74	const MEDIUM_VIEW_TYPE = 'medium';
75	
76	/**
77	 * Resolves the one image this mapper ever returns. `hoverImage`/`images` are never populated —
78	 * SFCC-83 AC 3 asks for "the product's index image" (singular), and the `recentlyViewed`
79	 * variation renders neither a hover-swap nor a gallery (see `zimmProductCard/index.tsx`'s
80	 * `recentlyViewed` row: `showHoverImageSwap: false`, and its render branch never forwards
81	 * `images` at all).
82	 *
83	 * Prefers `filterImageGroups` at `viewType: 'medium'` (a real, correctly-sized product image) —
84	 * `variationValues` is deliberately empty: a Recently Viewed rec is already one specific product,
85	 * not a search hit needing a variant pick the way `liveProductCardDemoMapper.ts`'s own
86	 * `resolveDemoVariant` handles, so that logic does not apply here. Falls back to Einstein's own
87	 * flat `image` field only when that filtering produces nothing usable — see
88	 * `RecentlyViewedProduct.image`'s own comment for what that field is.
89	 *
90	 * @returns `null` when neither source has a usable `src`. `ZimmProductCardMediaImage.alt` is
91	 *   required and non-empty, so there is no safe placeholder card to build without a real image —
92	 *   a card with an invented placeholder `src` would need an asset this codebase has no confirmed
93	 *   token or precedent for, so "no usable image" is treated the same as "no usable name" in
94	 *   `selectRecentlyViewedCard` below: a hard gate that yields no card at all. Returning `null`
95	 *   here is the only option that structurally cannot violate the non-empty-`alt` contract, since
96	 *   there is no returned object for `alt` to be empty on.
97	 */
98	const selectPrimaryImage = (product: RecentlyViewedProduct, productName: string): ZimmProductCardImage | null => {
99	  const filteredGroups = filterImageGroups(product.imageGroups ?? [], {
100	    viewType: MEDIUM_VIEW_TYPE,
101	    variationValues: {},
102	  }) as ShopperProductsTypes.ImageGroup[];
103	  const [groupImage] = filteredGroups[0]?.images ?? [];
104	
105	  const src = groupImage ? groupImage.disBaseLink || groupImage.link : product.image?.disBaseLink;
106	  if (!src) return null;
107	
108	  // ZimmProductCardMediaImage.alt is required and non-empty (unlike base ProductTile's
109	  // decorative alt: '' convention) — mirrors liveProductCardDemoMapper.ts's own fallback exactly.
110	  const alt = (groupImage ? groupImage.alt : product.image?.alt)?.trim() || productName;
111	  return { src, alt };
112	};
113	
114	/**
115	 * @param product - The merged Einstein rec + Commerce API product `fetchRecProductDetails`
116	 *   produces, or `undefined`/`null` while that data is not yet available.
117	 * @param formatPrice - Currency formatter, normally `intl.formatNumber`.
118	 * @returns Props for the `recentlyViewed` `ZimmProductCard` variation, or `null` when the rec has
119	 *   no usable name or no usable image — never a broken card, never a throw.
120	 */
121	export const selectRecentlyViewedCard = (
122	  product: RecentlyViewedProduct | undefined | null,
123	  formatPrice: FormatPrice,
124	): RecentlyViewedCard | null => {
125	  if (!product?.name) return null;
126	
127	  const primaryImage = selectPrimaryImage(product, product.name);
128	  if (!primaryImage) return null;
129	
130	  return {
131	    // Reads productId, not the SDK Product's own `id` — see RecentlyViewedProduct.productId's
132	    // own comment for why (guaranteed equal in practice, but productId is the field the real
133	    // runtime hook explicitly produces this way).
134	    id: product.productId,
135	    href: productUrlBuilder({ id: product.productId }),
136	    name: product.name,
137	    primaryImage,
138	    // No hardcoded fallback currency — if either is absent, skip formatting rather than guess,
139	    // matching productInfo.ts's own "no hardcoded fallback currency" comment.
140	    currentPrice:
141	      typeof product.price === 'number' && product.currency ? formatPrice(product.price, product.currency) : undefined,
142	  };
143	};

14	    },

19	 * `QueryClientProvider` — the same wrapper `_app-config`'s `withReactQuery(AppConfig, ...)`
20	 * mounts for every page in the real app, so a hook under test needs no provider of its own
21	 * beyond this. See `.claude/rules/testing.md` > Commerce SDK hooks for the equivalent

26	 * @returns the same result `@testing-library/react`'s `renderHook` returns
27	 */

29	  callback: (props: TProps) => TResult,

19	 * @returns {boolean}

22	    const [isIntersecting, setIntersecting] = useState(false)
23	
24	    const {useOnce, ...ioOptions} = options
25	
26	    useEffect(() => {
27	        if (!ref?.current) return
28	
29	        // Just set `isIntersecting` true if browser doesn't implement IntersectionObserver. If the use-case
30	        // is critical and you need to support very old browsers, a polyfill will need to be added.

41	            // so we just return a noop function.
